description: Defines the interface and data structures for managing HTTP server properties, including support for protocols like HTTP/2 and QUIC, alternative services, server stats, and persistent storage integration.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties
classes.description: Manages HTTP server properties such as protocol support, alternative services, and server stats, with optional persistence.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::PrefDelegate
classes.description: Interface for persistent preferences storage related to server properties.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::ServerInfo
classes.description: Metadata about a specific server, including support for SPDY, HTTP/1.1 requirements, alternative services, and network stats.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::ServerInfoMap
classes.description: LRU cache mapping server info keys to ServerInfo objects.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::QuicServerInfoMap
classes.description: LRU cache mapping QUIC server info keys to server info strings.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::ServerInfoMapKey
classes.description: Key for identifying server info entries, normalized for scheme and host.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::QuicServerInfoMapKey
classes.description: Key for identifying QUIC server info entries, including server ID and privacy mode.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Deletes all server property data, optionally asynchronously flushing to disk.

methods.name: SupportsRequestPriority
methods.description: Checks if a server supports request prioritization.

methods.name: GetSupportsSpdy
methods.description: Retrieves SPDY support status for a server.

methods.name: SetSupportsSpdy
methods.description: Sets SPDY support status for a server.

methods.name: RequiresHTTP11
methods.description: Checks if a server requires HTTP/1.1.

methods.name: SetHTTP11Required
methods.description: Marks a server as requiring HTTP/1.1.

methods.name: MaybeForceHTTP11
methods.description: Modifies SSL configuration to enforce HTTP/1.1 if needed.

methods.name: GetAlternativeServiceInfos
methods.description: Retrieves all alternative services for a given origin.

methods.name: SetHttp2AlternativeService
methods.description: Sets an HTTP/2 alternative service for an origin.

methods.name: SetQuicAlternativeService
methods.description: Sets a QUIC alternative service for an origin.

methods.name: SetAlternativeServices
methods.description: Sets multiple alternative services for an origin.

methods.name: MarkAlternativeServiceBroken
methods.description: Marks an alternative service as broken.

methods.name: MarkAlternativeServiceBrokenUntilDefaultNetworkChanges
methods.description: Marks an alternative service as broken until network change.

methods.name: MarkAlternativeServiceRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Marks an alternative service as recently broken.

methods.name: IsAlternativeServiceBroken
methods.description: Checks if an alternative service is currently broken.

methods.name: WasAlternativeServiceRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Checks if an alternative service was recently broken.

methods.name: ConfirmAlternativeService
methods.description: Confirms an alternative service is working.

methods.name: OnDefaultNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change event, clearing broken services.

methods.name: GetAlternativeServiceInfoAsValue
methods.description: Returns human-readable mapping of alternative services.

methods.name: SetServerNetworkStats
methods.description: Sets network stats for a server.

methods.name: ClearServerNetworkStats
methods.description: Clears network stats for a server.

methods.name: GetServerNetworkStats
methods.description: Retrieves network stats for a server.

methods.name: SetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Stores QUIC server info string for a server ID.

methods.name: GetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves QUIC server info string for a server ID.

methods.name: max_server_configs_stored_in_properties
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of server configs stored.

methods.name: SetMaxServerConfigsStoredInProperties
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of server configs to store.

methods.name: SetBrokenAlternativeServicesDelayParams
methods.description: Configures delay parameters for broken alternative services.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the properties are initialized.

methods.name: OnExpireBrokenAlternativeService
methods.description: Handles expiration of a broken alternative service.
